team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.desc: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Roost
moves.desc: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

team.abilityDesc: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.desc: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.desc: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and defensive stat changes.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.desc: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Roost
moves.desc: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

team.abilityDesc: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.desc: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.desc: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.desc: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
